name: tv_samsung
description: Control Samsung TV: power, volume, mute, home, hdmi1-4, netflix. Requires SAMSUNG_TV_IP on home hub.

name: tv_jvc
description: Control JVC TV via HDMI-CEC or IR bridge: power, volume, input_hdmi1.

name: speak_phonon
description: Speak text with on-device Phonon TTS through the home hub (offline, English 31m).

name: launch_game
description: Launch a game or big-picture mode: steam_bigpicture, steam_app:<id>, moonlight, or samsung_app:<name>.

name: scene_lounge
description: Run a named lounge scene: movie, gaming, off — dims TVs and sets inputs per home.env scenes.
